name: R-spondin 2
pathways: positive regulation of Wnt signaling pathway

function.text: RSPO2 encodes r-spondin-2. Annotated molecular activities include BMP receptor binding and signaling receptor binding. It participates in limb development and positive regulation of Wnt signaling pathway.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to tetraamelia syndrome 2 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
